summary: Carry current B12X master into beta: CUTLASS DSL 4.7.1, block-quantized launch heuristics, tensor-based API compatibility
compatibility: No user action required. B12X now requires CUTLASS DSL 4.7.1, which the runtime image installs (docker-116). The first start after updating compiles and tunes B12X kernels again for the new compiler, so it takes longer once.
details: The CUTLASS DSL compiler and its libraries move from 4.6.2 to 4.7.1.

Dense tiles and split-K for block-quantized weights are chosen from the codec, geometry, planned capacity, workspace limits and SM count, and MoE launches account for resident threads, without model-specific shape exceptions.

The tensor-based GEMM, MoE, attention and vLLM integration entry points are kept over the typed preparation APIs; callers without autotuning metadata get bounded dynamic preparation and heuristic planning.
